name: upload_image
description: Upload an image and get the markdown that embeds it. The image is anchored to a wiki page, so upload it to the page you are about to put it on, then insert the returned `markdown` with edit_doc/write_doc — uploading alone does not change the page. Supply the bytes base64-encoded. PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP are accepted, up to 10 MiB.

path.description: Wiki-relative path of the page the image belongs to (e.g. `guides/setup.md`). Must be an existing `.md` page. No leading slash, no `..`.

data_base64.description: The image file's bytes, base64-encoded. The format is detected from the bytes, so the file's extension does not matter.

alt_text.description: Alt text for the embedded image, used as the markdown link text. Describe what the image shows.
